verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's documented AI investigation path runs mainly through its official MCP server. It lets an external AI agent "investigate and diagnose latency or error spikes" and handle open-ended prompts like "Investigate latency in the api-gateway service", and its tool reference lists Canvas investigation tools. A community user confirms an LLM agent using Honeycomb's MCP server can generate integrated hypotheses. The built-in Query Assistant only translates natural language into queries, so the story largely relies on bringing your own agent rather than a native AI that proposes a root cause. Missing for 10: a documented first-party in-platform AI that investigates a fired alert or error, explicit probable-root-cause output, detail on what Canvas investigations produce, and independent hands-on corroboration of root-cause accuracy.
